# PropTrenz - Mexican Real Estate Market Intelligence

> PropTrenz is a data-driven platform for tracking real estate prices and market trends across Mexico. We provide interactive price maps, market insights, calculators, and comprehensive guides to help renters, buyers, investors make smarter real estate decisions.

## About PropTrenz

PropTrenz offers real estate market intelligence for Mexico, including:
- Interactive neighborhood price maps for major cities (Mexico City, Monterrey, Guadalajara)
- Rent price tracking and analysis
- Market insights and trends
- Real estate calculators (closing costs, ROI, ownership costs, seller costs)
- Comprehensive guides for renters, home buyers, investors in Mexico

## Data Sources

Our real estate data is sourced from:
- Banorte (Mexican bank mortgage data)
- SAT (Mexican tax authority)
- SHF (Sociedad Hipotecaria Federal)
- Local notaries and real estate professionals

PropTrenz is available in:

- Spanish (Español)
- Chinese (中文)
